newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise in morning on Dow's rebound.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise in morning on Dow's rebound.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning trade on Tuesday, as sentiment firmed after a rebound in the New York stock market on Monday and the dollar's rise against the yen, brokers said.
As of 0015 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was 158.52 points or 0.83 percent higher at 19,199.62. Its September futures gained 230 points to 19,230.
"Market participants were encouraged by New York's rebound overnight and the favourable dollar/yen rate for Japanese exporters," a market analyst at a major Japanese brokerage said.
